Give thanks to God the sovereign Lord;

Watts made this hymn from Psalm 136, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever. 2Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever. 3Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever. 4He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever. … 22 more verses PSALM 136 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 136
